constraints: Passing a vpAreaName that does not exist raises an error.
4D View Pro commands are normally accumulated in a command buffer for performance; this command executes the buffered batch immediately and empties the buffer.
If callback is provided, it only fires once all buffered commands AND any 4D custom functions they triggered have finished executing, so follow-up actions (save/print) can safely run after it fires.
callback receives the area name and a status object with .success, .errorCode, and .errorMessage properties.

overloadPatches.semanticRole: Immediately executes the buffered 4D View Pro command batch for an area and clears the buffer, optionally invoking a callback once execution (including any triggered custom functions) has fully completed.
